messages.content:
State:
{
 "seed_assertion": "Even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.",
 "sentences": {
  "1": "Even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.",
  "2": "Therefore, even if a DPIA is not required on 25 May 2018, it will be necessary, at the appropriate time, for the controller to conduct such a DPIA as part of its general accountability obligations.",
  "3": "If the processing is based on law which regulates the specific processing operation or operations and DPIA has been carried out as part of a general impact assessment when adopting that law, there is no obligation to conduct a separate DPIA, unless the Member State in question considers it necessary.",
  "4": "If the processing is based on law which regulates the specific processing operation or operations and DPIA has been carried out as part of a general impact assessment when adopting that law, there is no obligation to conduct a separate DPIA, unless the Member State in question considers it necessary.",
  "5": "It is a data controller's obligation to ensure a DPIA is carried out when required, at the appropriate time and contains all the detail required by the GDPR.",
  "6": "It is important to remember that it is a data controller's obligation to ensure a DPIA is carried out when required, at the appropriate time and contains all the detail required by the GDPR.",
  "7": "The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.",
  "8": "The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not, however, diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.",
  "9": "Where processing pursuant to point (c) or (e) of Article 6(1) has a legal basis in Union law or in the law of the Member State to which the controller is subject, and that law regulates the specific processing operation or set of operations in question, and a data protection impact assessment has already been carried out as part of a general impact assessment in the context of the adoption of that legal basis, the requirements of paragraphs 1 to 7 do not apply unless Member States deem it necessary to carry out such an assessment prior to processing activities.",
  "10": "Where processing pursuant to point (c) or (e) of Article 6 (1) has a legal basis in Union law or in the law of the Member State to which the controller is subject, that law regulates the specific processing operation or set of operations in question, and a data protection impact assessment has already been carried out as part of a general impact assessment in the context of the adoption of that legal basis, the DPIA requirements shall not apply unless Member States deem it to be necessary to carry out such an assessment prior to processing activities.",
  "11": "As part of the accountability principle, every data controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility and must assess whether a high risk is likely, even if they ultimately decide not to carry out a DPIA.",
  "12": "Systematic means that the processing occurs according to a system, is pre-arranged, organised or methodical, takes place as part of a general plan for data collection, or is carried out as part of a strategy."
 }
}

Question: Question about the seed assertion: Does any sentence state why this is done (the reason or the failure it prevents), other than 'the law/regulation requires it'? Does sentences["6"] state the element this question asks for?

Options:
- "states": The sentence explicitly states the element the question asks for.
- "partially": The sentence states part of the element, or states it only implicitly.
- "no": The sentence does not state the element; being on the same topic is not enough.

Respond as JSON only: {"choice": "states" | "partially" | "no"}.
